module autovcoder_019705 (
    input clk_i,
    input rst,
    output reg clk_o
);
  reg [8:0] clk_a;

  //50MHz
  always @(posedge clk_i or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[0] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[0] <= ~clk_a[0];
    end
  end
  //25MHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[0] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[1] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[1] <= ~clk_a[1];
    end
  end
  //12.5MHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[1] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[2] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[2] <= ~clk_a[2];
    end
  end
  //6.25MHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[2] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[3] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[3] <= ~clk_a[3];
    end
  end
  //3.125MHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[3] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[4] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[4] <= ~clk_a[4];
    end
  end
  //1.5625MHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[4] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[5] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[5] <= ~clk_a[5];
    end
  end
  //781.25kHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[5] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[6] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[6] <= ~clk_a[6];
    end
  end
  //390.625kHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[6] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[7] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[7] <= ~clk_a[7];
    end
  end
  //195.312kHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[7] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_a[8] <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_a[8] <= ~clk_a[8];
    end
  end
  //97.656kHz
  always @(posedge clk_a[8] or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      clk_o <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      clk_o <= ~clk_o;
    end
  end
endmodule
